notes: Claude API (first-party) list prices from the official pricing page, fetched 2026-10-09. Also valid for Claude Platform on AWS and Microsoft Foundry. Bedrock and Google Cloud price separately and are not covered.
Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute TTL) and 2x input (1-hour TTL). Cache reads are 0.1x input, except 0.025x on Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 and 0.05x on Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5.

Sonnet 5.5 cache reads: the official page says $0.10/MTok (0.05x). Claude Code's own cost-state ledger and the claude-api skill's cached model table (2026-10-06) use $0.20. The official page wins here, so Claude Code's own costUSD runs higher than ours on Sonnet 5.5 sessions that are heavy on cache reads.

Long context: only Haiku 5.5 has a tier. A request whose prompt (input + cache reads + cache writes) is over 100,000 tokens pays the longContext row. Other Claude 4.6+ models bill the full 1M window at standard rates.

inference_geo 'us' costs 1.1x on every token category for Claude 4.6+ models (earlier models reject the parameter). 'global' (the default) is standard. Web search is not multiplied. Geo values not listed here are priced at 1x.

'fast' (ModelPrice.fast) holds research-preview fast-mode rates (Claude API only): Opus 5.5 $8/$40, Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 $10/$50. Its cache rates apply the standard caching multipliers on top of fast pricing, as the pricing page documents. Opus 4.6 fast requests bill at standard rates.
Batch API (50% off) and Priority Tier are not modelled, because agent transcripts don't record them.

Keys ending in '*' cover dated snapshot ids, e.g. claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 snapshots drop the '-0' (claude-opus-4-20250514), so they are listed exactly. Broad family prefixes such as 'claude-opus-5*' are deliberately absent, so an unreleased model stays unpriced instead of being guessed.
Opus 4.1, Opus 4, Sonnet 4 and Haiku 3.5 are retired on the Claude API. They are kept for old transcripts.
